title: D-Link DCS-8300LHV2 ONVIF Hardcoded PIN Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of D-Link DCS-8300LHV2 IP cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the ONVIF API. The issue results from the use of a hardcoded PIN. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
